name: Hello
description: A guestbook that says hello. The smallest real Ava add-on, written to be read.

tools.name: greet
tools.description: Say hello to someone in the person's Hello guestbook: writes 'Hello, <name>!' into it and shows it in the Hello panel. It's kept in Hello's own storage on this computer; nothing leaves it.

name.description: Who to greet, e.g. 'Ada'. At most 60 characters.
